spec_version.en: Version of the spec format. Leave it out; Halo fills in `"1"`.
spec_version.zh: spec 格式的版本。不用写，Halo 会填为 `"1"`。

name.en: The name people see. For a skill it is also the folder name and the slash command, so a non-ASCII skill name is turned into an ASCII command name and the original is kept in `display_name`.
name.zh: 大家看到的名字。对技能来说它也是文件夹名和斜杠命令，所以非 ASCII 的技能名会被转成 ASCII 命令名，原名保存在 `display_name`。

display_name.en: Name to show when `name` is not presentable, such as a skill named in Chinese. A matching `i18n` entry wins over it.
display_name.zh: `name` 不适合直接显示时使用的名字，例如用中文命名的技能。`i18n` 中对应语言的名字优先。

version.en: Your version of the package, such as `1.0.0`. A Store update must carry a higher version.
version.zh: 这个包的版本，例如 `1.0.0`。发布到商店的新版本必须更高。

author.en: Who made it. When published, it becomes the namespace of the Store address, `<author>/<name>`. Optional for skills.
author.zh: 作者。发布后它会成为商店地址的命名空间：`<author>/<name>`。技能可以不写。

description.en: One or two sentences on what it does, shown in lists and the Store.
description.zh: 用一两句话说明它做什么，显示在列表和商店里。

icon.en: An emoji or an image URL. Anything else falls back to the type icon; a Digital Human without an icon gets a generated avatar.
icon.zh: 一个 emoji 或图片 URL。其他值会退回类型图标；没有图标的数字人会得到自动生成的头像。

permissions.en: Capabilities to turn on at install: `ai-browser`, `ai-terminal`, `email`, `im-push` (on by default anyway), `halo-api-ref` (Operate Halo) and `conversation-collab` (Conversation Collaboration), both off by default. A spec can only add a capability; the user can still turn any of them off.
permissions.zh: 安装时要打开的能力：`ai-browser`、`ai-terminal`、`email`、`im-push`（这四项默认就是开的），以及默认关闭的 `halo-api-ref`（操作 Halo）和 `conversation-collab`（对话协作）。spec 只能增加能力，用户仍可以关掉其中任何一项。

requires.en: MCP servers and skills it depends on.
requires.zh: 依赖的 MCP 服务器和技能。

requires.mcps.en: MCP servers it uses. Runs get only the servers listed here, and a run doesn't start while one of them is not installed, turned off, waiting for sign-in or failing. A chat gets every server of its workspace and the global ones, except those marked `enabled: false`.
requires.mcps.zh: 它使用的 MCP 服务器。运行只拿到这里列出的服务器；其中有服务器没有安装、被关闭、等待登录或连接失败时，运行不会开始。聊天时它能用工作区和全局的全部服务器，标了 `enabled: false` 的除外。

requires.mcps[].id.en: Id of an installed MCP server.
requires.mcps[].id.zh: 已安装的 MCP 服务器的 id。

requires.mcps[].reason.en: Why it needs the server, shown next to the dependency.
requires.mcps[].reason.zh: 为什么需要这个服务器，显示在依赖旁边。

requires.mcps[].bundled.en: Meant to mark an MCP server shipped inside the package.
requires.mcps[].bundled.zh: 本意是标记随包附带的 MCP 服务器。

requires.mcps[].enabled.en: `false` keeps the declaration but stops this Digital Human from using the server, in runs and in chat. The server itself stays on for everyone else.
requires.mcps[].enabled.zh: 设为 `false` 会保留声明，但这位数字人在运行和聊天中都不再使用这个服务器。服务器本身对其他人照常可用。

requires.skills.en: Skills to install together with it, as ids or objects. Every skill in its workspace or global scope is available to it anyway; this list only decides what gets installed.
requires.skills.zh: 随它一起安装的技能，可以写 id 或对象。它所在工作区和全局范围里的技能本来就都能用；这个列表只决定要安装哪些。

requires.skills[].bundled.en: `true` when the skill ships inside the package under `skills/<id>/` rather than coming from the Store.
requires.skills[].bundled.zh: 技能放在包内 `skills/<id>/` 下、而不是来自商店时设为 `true`。

requires.skills[].files.en: For a bundled skill, its files relative to `skills/<id>/`, such as `SKILL.md` and `index.js`.
requires.skills[].files.zh: 包内技能的文件列表，路径相对于 `skills/<id>/`，例如 `SKILL.md` 和 `index.js`。

config_schema.en: The settings form the user fills in at install and can change later. Every run and chat hands the Digital Human the current values by `key`, with defaults filled in.
config_schema.zh: 用户在安装时填写、之后还能修改的设置表单。每次运行和聊天，数字人都会拿到按 `key` 给出的当前值，未填写的用默认值补上。

config_schema[].type.en: Input control. `text` is multi-line, `string` single-line. There is no password or secret type, because the values are passed to the AI as plain text: for sites that need a login, use `browser_login`.
config_schema[].type.zh: 输入控件。`text` 是多行，`string` 是单行。没有密码或密钥类型，因为这些值会以明文交给 AI：需要登录的网站请用 `browser_login`。

config_schema[].required.en: Marks the field as required on the form.

config_schema[].default.en: Value filled in until the user changes it.
config_schema[].default.zh: 用户修改之前使用的值。

config_schema[].placeholder.en: Hint shown in an empty field.
config_schema[].placeholder.zh: 字段为空时显示的提示。

config_schema[].options.en: Choices of a `select` field, at least one.

config_schema[].options[].value.en: Value stored when it is chosen.

store.en: Store listing details, used when the package is published or installed from a store.
store.zh: 商店条目信息，发布或从商店安装时使用。

store.slug.en: Store address of the package. Publishing sets it to `<author>/<name>` for you.
store.slug.zh: 包在商店里的地址。发布时会自动设为 `<author>/<name>`。

store.category.en: Store category it is listed under.

store.tags.en: Tags that help people find it in the Store.
store.tags.zh: 帮助别人在商店里找到它的标签。

store.locale.en: Main language of the package, as a language tag such as `zh-CN`.
store.locale.zh: 包的主要语言，用语言标签表示，例如 `zh-CN`。

store.min_app_version.en: Oldest Halo version it is meant for. The Store shows it; Halo does not block older versions.
store.min_app_version.zh: 适用的最低 Halo 版本。商店会显示它，但 Halo 不会因此阻止旧版本安装。

store.license.en: License, as an SPDX identifier such as `MIT`. Kept with the package.
store.license.zh: 许可证，使用 SPDX 标识，例如 `MIT`。随包保存。

store.homepage.en: Project homepage. Kept with the package.

store.repository.en: Source repository. Kept with the package.
store.repository.zh: 源码仓库地址。随包保存。

i18n.en: Translations of the name, description, settings form and login labels, keyed by language tag such as `en` or `zh-CN`.
i18n.zh: 名称、简介、设置表单和登录标签的翻译，按语言标签区分，例如 `en`、`zh-CN`。

i18n.<locale>.config_schema.en: Translations of settings fields, keyed by the field `key`.
i18n.<locale>.config_schema.zh: 设置字段的翻译，按字段的 `key` 区分。

i18n.<locale>.config_schema.<key>.option.en: Translated choice labels, keyed by the choice value.
i18n.<locale>.config_schema.<key>.option.zh: 翻译后的选项文字，按选项的值区分。

i18n.<locale>.browser_login.en: Translated login labels, keyed by the `browser_login` URL.
i18n.<locale>.browser_login.zh: 登录标签的翻译，按 `browser_login` 的 URL 区分。

type.en: Kind of package: `automation` (a Digital Human), `mcp`, `skill`, or `extension` (reserved).
type.zh: 包的类型：`automation`（数字人）、`mcp`、`skill`，或保留的 `extension`。

system_prompt.en: The Digital Human's instructions: its role, its steps, what it must never do and when to ask. Everything it does on its own follows from this text.
system_prompt.zh: 数字人的指令：它的角色、步骤、绝不能做的事，以及什么时候要来问人。它自己做的一切都由这段文字决定。

subscriptions.en: When it runs on its own. Leave it out for a Digital Human that only answers chats and messages from bots.
subscriptions.zh: 它什么时候自己开始运行。只回复聊天和机器人消息的数字人不需要写。

subscriptions[].id.en: Id of this trigger, unique in the spec. Without one, triggers are numbered `0`, `1`, … in order.
subscriptions[].id.zh: 这个触发器的 id，在 spec 内唯一。不写时按顺序编号为 `0`、`1`……

subscriptions[].source.type.en: `schedule`, `file` and `webhook` start runs. `webpage`, `rss`, `custom` and `wecom` are accepted but nothing produces their events. Messages to a bot reach a Digital Human through its bot binding, not through a trigger.
subscriptions[].source.type.zh: 会启动运行的是 `schedule`、`file` 和 `webhook`。`webpage`、`rss`、`custom` 和 `wecom` 可以写，但没有任何事件来源会产生它们的事件。发给机器人的消息通过机器人绑定交给数字人，不需要触发器。

subscriptions[].source.config.every@sche.en: Interval such as `30m`, `2h` or `1d` (units `s`, `m`, `h`, `d`). If both `every` and `cron` are set, `every` wins.
subscriptions[].source.config.every@sche.zh: 间隔，例如 `30m`、`2h`、`1d`（单位 `s`、`m`、`h`、`d`）。同时写了 `every` 和 `cron` 时，以 `every` 为准。

subscriptions[].source.config.cron@sched.en: Cron expression with 5 fields, or 6 with seconds first, such as `0 9 * * 1-5`. It is checked when the spec is saved.
subscriptions[].source.config.cron@sched.zh: cron 表达式，5 段，或以秒开头的 6 段，例如 `0 9 * * 1-5`。保存 spec 时会校验。

subscriptions[].source.config.workday_ca.en: `true` runs only on mainland China working days, including make-up workdays, and skips public holidays. Use it with a schedule that fires every day, not `1-5`.
subscriptions[].source.config.workday_ca.zh: 设为 `true` 时只在中国大陆的工作日运行，包括调休上班日，跳过法定节假日。请搭配每天都触发的计划，不要用 `1-5`。

subscriptions[].source.config@file.en: Which file changes start a run.
subscriptions[].source.config@file.zh: 哪些文件变化会启动运行。

subscriptions[].source.config.pattern@fi.en: Glob matched against the changed file's path inside its own workspace, such as `inbox/*.csv`. It matches the same path in every workspace Halo watches, not only this one.
subscriptions[].source.config.pattern@fi.zh: 与变动文件在它所在工作区内的相对路径匹配的通配模式，例如 `inbox/*.csv`。它会匹配 Halo 监视的每个工作区里的同一路径，而不只是这一个。

subscriptions[].source.config.path@file.en: Folder whose files count, matched as part of the absolute path. Halo does not limit a file trigger to the Digital Human's own workspace: changes in any workspace it watches (those open in the app and those of other file triggers) count. Set `path` to a folder inside this workspace to keep the trigger there.
subscriptions[].source.config.path@file.zh: 只算这个文件夹里的文件，与绝对路径做部分匹配。Halo 不会把文件触发限定在数字人自己的工作区：它监视的任何工作区（在应用里打开的，以及其他文件触发所在的）发生变化都算。把 `path` 设为本工作区里的文件夹，触发才只限于那里。

subscriptions[].source.config@webhook.en: An HTTP endpoint at `/hooks/<path>` that other systems post JSON events to.
subscriptions[].source.config@webhook.zh: 位于 `/hooks/<path>` 的 HTTP 入口，其他系统向它推送 JSON 事件。

subscriptions[].source.config.path@webho.en: Path after `/hooks/`. Use lower case and a path no other Digital Human uses.
subscriptions[].source.config.path@webho.zh: `/hooks/` 之后的路径。请用小写，并且不要与其他数字人重复。

subscriptions[].source.config.secret@web.en: Shared secret for the HMAC-SHA256 signature every request must carry. Without it, anyone who can reach Halo can start the Digital Human.
subscriptions[].source.config.secret@web.zh: 每个请求都必须携带的 HMAC-SHA256 签名所用的共享密钥。不设置时，任何能访问 Halo 的人都能启动这位数字人。

subscriptions[].source.config@webpage.en: Meant to watch a web page for changes. To check a page, use a `schedule` and let the Digital Human open it in the AI Browser.
subscriptions[].source.config@webpage.zh: 本意是监视网页变化。要检查网页，请用 `schedule`，让数字人在 AI 浏览器里打开它。

subscriptions[].source.config.watch@webp.en: What to watch on the page.

subscriptions[].source.config.selector@w.zh: 要关注的 CSS 选择器。

subscriptions[].source.config@rss.en: Meant to follow an RSS feed. Use a `schedule` that reads the feed instead.
subscriptions[].source.config@rss.zh: 本意是订阅 RSS 源。请改用定时读取订阅源的 `schedule`。

subscriptions[].source.config@custom.en: Free-form settings for a custom event source. Halo has none built in.
subscriptions[].source.config@custom.zh: 自定义事件来源的任意配置。Halo 没有内置这样的来源。

subscriptions[].source.config@wecom.en: Meant for WeCom messages. To have a Digital Human answer a WeCom bot, bind the bot to it in Settings › Message Channels.
subscriptions[].source.config@wecom.zh: 本意是接收企业微信消息。要让数字人回复企业微信机器人，请在 设置 › 消息通道 中把机器人绑定给它。

subscriptions[].frequency.en: Meant as the range of intervals a user may pick. Halo does not enforce it.
subscriptions[].frequency.zh: 本意是用户可选的间隔范围。Halo 不会据此做限制。

subscriptions[].frequency.default.en: Suggested interval. It does not change when runs happen: set the schedule's `every` or `cron` for that.
subscriptions[].frequency.default.zh: 建议的间隔。它不会改变运行时间：要改运行时间，请修改计划的 `every` 或 `cron`。

subscriptions[].frequency.min.en: Meant as the shortest interval a user may pick.
subscriptions[].frequency.min.zh: 本意是用户可选的最短间隔。

subscriptions[].frequency.max.en: Meant as the longest interval a user may pick.
subscriptions[].frequency.max.zh: 本意是用户可选的最长间隔。

subscriptions[].config_key.en: Meant to feed a setting into the trigger. It must name an existing `config_schema` key, or the spec is rejected, but the value is never used.
subscriptions[].config_key.zh: 本意是把某个设置项的值交给触发器。它必须是已有的 `config_schema` key，否则 spec 校验不通过，但这个值不会被使用。

filters.en: Meant as rules that drop events before a run starts. Put such conditions in the system prompt instead.
filters.zh: 本意是在运行开始前过滤事件的规则。请把这类条件写进系统提示词。

memory_schema.en: What the Digital Human should keep in its memory file between runs, such as processed ids or a last-run time. It guides the AI; nothing checks it.
memory_schema.zh: 数字人在两次运行之间要记在记忆文件里的内容，例如已处理的 id、上次运行时间。它是给 AI 的指引，不会被校验。

memory_schema.<field>.type.en: Kind of value, as a hint such as `string`, `number`, `date` or `array`.
memory_schema.<field>.type.zh: 值的种类，作为提示，例如 `string`、`number`、`date`、`array`。

memory_schema.<field>.description.en: What the entry holds and how to update it.
memory_schema.<field>.description.zh: 这一项记什么、怎样更新。

output.en: Meant to configure notifications and output format. Ask for notifications in the system prompt instead: the Digital Human sends them through the notification channels set up in Settings.
output.zh: 本意是配置通知和输出格式。请在系统提示词里写明要发通知：数字人会通过 设置 里配置的通知通道发送。

output.notify.system.en: Desktop notifications. The user sets them per Digital Human under Messages & Notifications › System Notifications.
output.notify.system.zh: 桌面通知。由用户在每位数字人的 消息与通知 › 系统通知 中设置。

escalation.en: How long its questions wait for an answer. The Digital Human can always stop and ask.
escalation.zh: 它的提问等待回答的时长。数字人随时都可以停下来提问。

escalation.enabled.en: `false` does not stop it from asking, and `true` changes nothing. How far it may act alone comes from the system prompt.
escalation.enabled.zh: 设为 `false` 并不能阻止它提问，设为 `true` 也没有变化。它能自己做到哪一步，由系统提示词决定。

escalation.timeout_hours.en: Hours a question waits before it expires; the run then ends as failed. Without it, a question waits until someone answers.
escalation.timeout_hours.zh: 提问等待的小时数，超时后提问失效，这次运行以失败结束。不写时，提问会一直等到有人回答。

recommended_model.en: Model to suggest. Shown as a hint where the user picks the model; it does not switch the model.
recommended_model.zh: 推荐使用的模型。在用户选择模型的地方作为提示显示，不会自动切换模型。

browser_login.en: Websites the user must be signed in to in the AI Browser before it can work. Halo asks the user to sign in; the Digital Human never sees the password.
browser_login.zh: 数字人工作前，用户需要在 AI 浏览器里登录的网站。Halo 会请用户登录，数字人永远拿不到密码。

browser_login[].label.en: Name of the site, shown to the user.

mcp_server.en: How to start or reach the MCP server.
mcp_server.zh: 怎样启动或连接这个 MCP 服务器。

mcp_server.transport.en: `stdio` starts a local command; `sse` and `streamable-http` connect to a server URL.
mcp_server.transport.zh: `stdio` 启动一个本地命令；`sse` 和 `streamable-http` 连接一个服务器地址。

mcp_server.command.en: For `stdio`, the program to run, such as `npx`. For `sse` and `streamable-http`, the server URL: there is no separate `url` field.
mcp_server.command.zh: `stdio` 时是要运行的程序，例如 `npx`。`sse` 和 `streamable-http` 时是服务器地址：没有单独的 `url` 字段。

mcp_server.env.en: Environment variables for the command. Numbers and booleans are turned into strings. Values are stored as written, so keep keys out of shared packages.
mcp_server.env.zh: 命令的环境变量。数字和布尔值会转成字符串。值按原样保存，不要把密钥放进要分享的包。

mcp_server.headers.en: HTTP headers for `sse` and `streamable-http`, such as an authorization header. Stored as written.
mcp_server.headers.zh: `sse` 和 `streamable-http` 使用的 HTTP 请求头，例如鉴权头。按原样保存。

skill:author.en: Who made it. Optional for a skill. When published, it becomes the namespace of the Store address, `<author>/<name>`.
skill:author.zh: 作者。技能可以不写。发布后它会成为商店地址的命名空间：`<author>/<name>`。

skill_content.en: The whole `SKILL.md` of a one-file skill.
skill_content.zh: 单文件技能的完整 `SKILL.md` 内容。

skill_files.en: Every file of the skill, keyed by its path in the skill folder. Its `SKILL.md` wins over `skill_content`.
skill_files.zh: 技能的全部文件，按它在技能文件夹中的路径区分。其中的 `SKILL.md` 优先于 `skill_content`。
